tech.title: Google defends $15B India AI hub as water and power fears grow in Visakhapatnam
tech.summary: Google is publicly defending its $15 billion, gigawatt-scale AI hub with Adani near Visakhapatnam, saying it will use air cooling and will not take power away from local communities. Residents and campaigners remain worried about water, land and electricity in an already stressed coastal city, and a court challenge over environmental clearances is still running.

tech.title: US reverses course, lets UK test US AI models early again
tech.summary: The Trump administration has reversed a request that US labs not share new models with Britain's AI Security Institute before release, according to the Telegraph via Reuters. American developers can now give the UK early access for safety testing, a softer stance that also follows a new US requirement to report AI security incidents.

tech.title: Axe Compute rings Nasdaq bell today, touts $3.45B in signed AI contracts
tech.summary: Axe Compute, a provider of dedicated GPU capacity for enterprises, rings the Nasdaq opening bell on October 12. The company says it has built more than $3.45 billion in signed contracts in under a year as demand for guaranteed AI compute keeps rising.

tech.title: Valeo brings AI, software-defined cars and 800V EV tech to Paris Motor Show
tech.summary: Valeo is showcasing AI, software-defined vehicle platforms, ADAS and electrification at the Paris Motor Show from October 12 to 18. Highlights include its anSWer software suite, Smart Safety 360, SCALA 3 LiDAR for higher-level automation, and an 800V platform it says can charge 0-80% in 12 minutes.

tech.title: Microsoft and Nvidia team up on $2,599 Surface Laptop Ultra for on-device AI
tech.summary: Microsoft and Nvidia unveiled the Surface Laptop Ultra, powered by Nvidia's RTX Spark chip and built to run AI models locally. The top configuration offers 128GB unified memory and a claimed 1 petaflop of AI performance, with shipments starting October 16 and a starting price of $2,599.

tech.title: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and SpaceXAI hit with antitrust lawsuit over 'pacing' AI
tech.summary: A consumer lawsuit accuses Anthropic, OpenAI, Google and SpaceXAI of illegally coordinating to slow AI development after their leaders publicly backed an essay calling for limits on unchecked frontier progress. Plaintiffs seek class certification and argue subscribers paid for products that improved more slowly than competition would have allowed; the companies had not commented in the report.

pakistan.title: Emergency and governor's rule imposed in KP; PTI calls it undemocratic
pakistan.summary: The federal government imposed emergency under Article 232 and governor's rule under Article 234 in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa after presidential approval, citing the provincial government's disengagement from counterterrorism. A technocratic advisory council was formed, a new chief secretary appointed, troops authorised, and internet disruptions reported in parts of Peshawar. PTI condemned the move and said it would challenge it.

pakistan.title: Pakistan seal T20I series 2-0 with 82-run win over Sri Lanka in Rawalpindi
pakistan.summary: Pakistan beat Sri Lanka by 82 runs in the second T20I to take an unassailable 2-0 series lead. Maaz Sadaqat made 96 off 51 and captain Sahibzada Farhan 73 off 44 as Pakistan posted 215-3, before Mohammad Imran's 3-11 helped restrict Sri Lanka to 133-7.

pakistan.title: IMF staff deal could unlock $1.2B for Pakistan, pending board approval
pakistan.summary: The IMF reached a staff-level agreement with Pakistan on its lending programme reviews, potentially unlocking about $1.21 billion. If the board approves, about $1 billion would come under the Extended Fund Facility and $210 million under the climate-focused facility, taking total disbursements to around $5.7 billion, though risks from energy prices and geopolitics remain elevated.

pakistan.title: Six Pakistanis injured in Riyadh airport attack; PM vows support for Saudi Arabia 'in every possible way'
pakistan.summary: Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif condemned the Houthi attack on Riyadh's King Khalid International Airport, which Saudi authorities said killed 12 and injured over 300. Deputy PM Ishaq Dar said six Pakistani nationals were injured and directed the embassy in Riyadh to assist them, while Pakistan reaffirmed its defence commitment to the Kingdom under the Makkah agreement.

pakistan.title: Beneath the IMF deal: reserves up, but poverty and exports still tell a harder story
pakistan.summary: A Dawn editorial notes the IMF staff deal passed with little drama and reserves are around $21.5 billion, but inflation was still 10.3% in September, growth of 3.6% leaves thin per-capita gains, and World Bank poverty was put at about 42.4% for 2025. Goods exports fell while imports rose, widening the trade deficit, and the same reform list keeps repeating.

pakistan.title: PSL 12 confirmed for March 18 to May 2, 2027 with eight teams
pakistan.summary: The PCB confirmed HBL PSL 12 will run from March 18 to May 2, 2027, retaining the expanded eight-team format for a second season. Defending champions are Peshawar Zalmi from PSL 11. Direct signings, retentions, trades and the player auction will follow, with full schedule and venues to be announced later.
